name: customers
title: Customers
summary: The customer side of an account: profile, saved addresses, marketing consent, recently viewed products, the Account tab overview, guest order access, data export and account closure, and the staff view of customer accounts with notes and recorded account actions. Credentials, sessions and verification belong to identity.
owns: Customer profile (name, phone, member since) linked one-to-one to an identity user
Saved delivery addresses with a default; checkout copies the address into the order, so later changes never alter accepted orders
Marketing preferences per channel (email, SMS, push promotions, wishlist alerts, personalised recommendations) with a consent log; essential order messages are always on
Recently viewed products for customers and guest sessions (launch feature on the home page)
Account overview aggregate for the Account tab (orders in progress, open returns, unread messages, store credit, recent orders, open cases, delay alerts)
Guest order access: lookup by order reference and checkout email, and emailing order links
Customer account status (Active, Under review, Restricted, Suspended, Closed) and scoped restrictions (messaging, ordering, reviews) with reason, end date and appeal route
Admin customer list and detail, internal notes and account actions that always record a reason
Personal data export requests and account closure requests
notOwns: Email, password, 2-step verification, devices and sessions: identity (account actions call identity in-process)
Orders, returns, cases, messages, store credit: orders, returns, support, messaging, wallet (the overview only reads them)
Wishlist and price or availability alerts: wishlist (phase 3); the wishlistAlerts consent flag lives here so one preference page covers all promotional messages
Notification delivery and channel routing: notifications (reads consent from here)
Abuse reports about customers: trust (shown read-only in the admin detail)

publicApi.name: customerLocation
publicApi.desc: The customer's point from their geocoded default delivery address (city and label from that address), or null when they have no default address or it could not be geocoded. The store then shows the city without a distance. No device location is used.

publicApi.name: geocodeAddress
publicApi.signature: (input: { line1?: string, city: string, region: string, postalCode?: string, country?: string }) => GeoPoint | null
publicApi.desc: A point for an address through the geocoder provider (ZIP centroid, falling back to the city centroid), or null when unknown or no provider is configured. Other modules geocode staff-entered addresses (restaurants, providers, dealers) with it.

stateMachines.name: Customer account status
stateMachines.notes: Restricted means at least one active scoped restriction (messaging, ordering, reviews or account). Suspended stops new orders, messages and reviews. In every state except closed, existing orders, returns, refunds and cases stay reachable by the customer and staff (plan ch. 17, scenario 7). Close by staff requires reason code and runs the same obligation check as a customer request unless the reason is suspected fraud.

stateMachines.name: Account restriction
stateMachines.notes: Lift requires a reason. The expire job runs when endsAt passes. When the last active restriction ends the account returns to active.

stateMachines.name: Data request
stateMachines.notes: Exports: requested → processing → ready (link emailed, valid exportLinkValidDays) → expired. Closures: requested stays open for closureCoolingOffDays (customer can cancel), then the job re-checks obligations and completes; if new obligations appeared it keeps waiting and tells the customer.

endpoints.summary: Account tab home: tiles, alerts, recent orders, open cases and returns
endpoints.desc: One call renders account/overview on web and Android. Aggregated in-process with a 300 ms budget per source: orders.countInProgress + orders.listRecentForCustomer + orders.listDelayedItemsForCustomer (orders in progress, recent orders, delay alerts), returns.listOpenForCustomer (open returns tile and list), messaging.unreadCount (unread messages), support.listOpenCasesForCustomer (open cases), wallet.getBalance (store credit, phase 3; otherwise available=false), payments.listFailedPaymentsForCustomer (payments that failed after the order was placed, last 7 days). A source that is disabled or times out is listed in `unavailable` instead of failing the page. Alerts: item_delayed (delayed packages), payment_being_checked (recent orders whose payment is being checked), payment_failed (an order cancelled because its payment finally failed, last 7 days), return_action_needed (an open return waiting on the customer: a question to answer, or approved and to be sent back), case_waiting_on_you (an open case waiting on the customer).

Request a copy of my data

endpoints.desc: Newest first. Cancelled data exports are left out unless includeCancelled is true (they are kept for the audit trail).

endpoints.summary: Can I close my account now, and what blocks it
endpoints.desc: Counts open orders (orders), open returns and pending refunds (returns, payments), open cases (support) and store credit (wallet).

endpoints.summary: Request account closure
endpoints.desc: Refused with CLOSURE_BLOCKED (details.blockers) while obligations are open. Otherwise scheduled after closureCoolingOffDays; the customer can cancel until then. Requires a recent sign-in (identity re-auth token).

endpoints.summary: Cancel a pending closure or export request
Find a guest order by reference and checkout email
endpoints.desc: Verifies the pair with orders (orders.findGuestOrder), then calls identity.grantGuestOrderAccess(guestSessionId, orderId, email, 'lookup') so the caller's guest session can open the order in orders, shipping, returns and support. Wrong combinations return the same GUEST_ORDER_NOT_FOUND without saying which part was wrong. Only guest orders open this way (owner decision G29e): a reference that belongs to a registered customer's order answers GUEST_ORDER_SIGN_IN_REQUIRED whatever email was given, so the answer never confirms the email. Limited per IP and per email.

endpoints.summary: Email fresh links to every guest order placed with this email
endpoints.desc: Looks up guest orders for the email in orders and calls identity.issueOrderLink for each; notifications sends one email. Always answers 202 so it cannot be used to probe which emails have orders.

endpoints.summary: One-click stop of promotional messages from an email or SMS link
endpoints.desc: Token is signed by notifications and names customer and channel. Recorded in the consent log with source unsubscribe_link. Never affects essential messages.

endpoints.summary: Guest buyers (orders without an account) with order count and spend
endpoints.desc: The page total gives the header count (e.g. 1,212 guest buyers). Orders open through orders' guest order lookup; a guest who registers moves to the customer list.

endpoints.summary: Customer accounts with orders, spend, open cases, status and verification

q.desc: Name, email, phone, CU- reference or order reference (resolved through orders)

endpoints.desc: hasOpenCases and hasAbuseReports are applied before paging: the id sets come from support.customerIdsWithOpenCases and trust.subjectIdsWithReports('customer') and filter the query, so pages are full and total is right. When the source module is off the filter is refused (VALIDATION_FAILED, details.unavailable) rather than ignored.

endpoints.summary: Customer detail: profile, orders, cases, messages, notes, abuse reports, restrictions
endpoints.desc: Aggregates in-process: identity (sign-in summary), orders (count, spend, recent), support (open cases), messaging (conversation summary), trust (reports filed by and against). Missing sources are listed in `unavailable`. Each view writes an audit entry (customers.customer.view, shown in the audit log); it is not an AccountActionRecord: recentActions lists only actions that change the account.

endpoints.summary: Add an internal note
Apply an account action with a recorded reason
endpoints.desc: send_password_reset and sign_out_everywhere call identity and need customers.accounts.security. Restrict, suspend, reinstate and close need customers.accounts.act and go through the account status machine. Restricting or closing stops new orders; existing orders, returns, refunds and cases stay open and reachable. Closing an account with open obligations needs a second reviewer (access approval request).
endpoints.approval: Approval action customers.accounts.close-with-obligations. Closing an account that still has open orders, returns or cases needs a second reviewer

Account action history for one customer
Export the filtered customer list

consumes.name: access.approval.decided
consumes.does: Finish a staff account closure that needed approval (approved: close; rejected, cancelled or expired: revert the pending closure)

consumes.name: orders.order.placed
consumes.does: When guestEmail is set, add or update the guest buyer row (order count, spend, last order; name from the payload's contactName)

consumes.name: identity.user.registered
consumes.does: Create the customer profile, default marketing preferences (all promotional channels off unless opted in at registration) and the first consent log rows; remove the guest buyer row with the same email

consumes.name: identity.user.verified
consumes.does: Mark email or phone verified (orders attaches guest orders with that email itself)

consumes.name: identity.guest_session.claimed
consumes.does: Merge the guest session's recently viewed list into the customer's list (newest view wins) and delete the guest rows

consumes.name: identity.email.changed
consumes.does: Update the mirrored email and its verification date

consumes.name: identity.account.closed
consumes.does: If identity closed the account directly (staff tool), move the customer to closed and stop promotional consent

consumes.name: orders.order.placed
consumes.does: Update order count and spend, and lastUsedAt of the saved address named by the payload's deliveryAddressId (no orders lookup). Idempotent per event (inbox)

consumes.name: trust.enforcement.recorded
consumes.does: When the target is a customer (restrict messaging, ordering, reviews or account), create the restriction with the enforcement's reason, end date and appeal route

consumes.name: trust.enforcement.reversed
consumes.does: Undo what the enforcement did to a customer: lift every active restriction with that trustEnforcementId (lift reason: the reversal reason, actor system on behalf of trust), return the account to active when none remain, publish customers.account.restriction_lifted and customers.account.status_changed, and record it in the action history. Idempotent; restrictions already lifted or expired stay as they are

consumes.name: catalog.product.merged
consumes.does: Repoint recently viewed rows from the duplicate to the kept product

Send password reset links and sign a customer out everywhere

approvalActions.desc: Staff closure of a customer account that still has open orders, returns or cases
approvalActions.approvers: Customer Support Manager or Business Owner (not the requester)

jobs.name: customers.expire-restrictions
jobs.does: Expire restrictions past endsAt; return the account to active when none remain

jobs.name: customers.build-data-exports
jobs.does: Process requested exports: call exportCustomerData on every enabled module that declares it (orders, returns, support, messaging, reviews, wishlist, wallet, payments…) with the customerId and accountId, write one file per section plus the customer's attachments into a ZIP in media, mark ready, publish customers.data_export.ready. A module that throws fails the export (retried), never silently left out; one that declares the hook but is off is listed in the README under notIncluded. There is no list-based fallback: a module holding customer data must declare the hook

jobs.name: customers.expire-export-links
jobs.does: Expire ready exports after exportLinkValidDays and delete the file

jobs.name: customers.complete-closures
jobs.does: For closures past the cooling-off date, re-check obligations; close the account, anonymise profile and addresses, keep order references. When obligations block it, keep the request and publish customers.closure.delayed (once per new set of blockers)

jobs.name: customers.prune-recently-viewed
jobs.does: Delete rows older than recentlyViewedRetentionDays and guest rows whose session expired

jobs.name: customers.geocode-addresses
jobs.does: Backfill: geocode saved addresses that were never geocoded (addresses saved before geocoding existed, or while the geocoder failed), and retry addresses the geocoder could not place after a week. Batches of 200; defaults first

integrations.name: Address validation provider (optional)
integrations.purpose: Normalise US addresses and detect PO boxes; format rules only when not configured

integrations.name: Geocoder (geocoder port)
integrations.purpose: A point (lat/lng) for each saved address and for addresses other modules pass to geocodeAddress. Development: a built-in table of ZIP centroids for the Portland–Vancouver–Salem metro and city centroids for the seed data (CA, OR, WA), city fallback. Production: no provider is configured yet, so addresses keep no point and the store shows the city without distances

ADDRESS_LIMIT_REACHED.meaning: The customer already has maxAddresses saved addresses

ADDRESS_UNDELIVERABLE.meaning: Outside the service region or not deliverable; details.issues explains

CLOSURE_BLOCKED.meaning: Open orders, returns, cases, pending refunds or credit; details.blockers lists them

DATA_REQUEST_IN_PROGRESS.meaning: A request of the same kind is already open

GUEST_ORDER_NOT_FOUND.meaning: No guest order matches that reference and email

GUEST_ORDER_SIGN_IN_REQUIRED.meaning: The order belongs to a registered customer: sign in to see it (answered whatever email was given, so it never confirms the email)

UNSUBSCRIBE_TOKEN_INVALID.meaning: The unsubscribe link is invalid or expired

notes: Customer id is separate from the identity user id (one-to-one). Other modules store customerId; the guest order flow stores email only. Ids are never interchangeable: callers that hold an account id resolve it with getCustomerByUserId, and no API accepts either.

Data export contract: customers owns the export ZIP; each module owns its part through the exportCustomerData hook (FORMAT.md; common.CustomerDataSection). Needed from: orders, returns, support, messaging, reviews, wishlist, wallet, payments (saved methods, masked). Anonymisation after closure is each module's consumer of customers.account.closed.

Recently viewed is owned here at launch (brief: phase 1, used on the home page) instead of the phase-3 wishlist module listed in the architecture doc. Wishlist reads it through listRecentlyViewed. optionalDeps gain catalog and offers for current price and availability.

Overview aggregation uses ctx.tryUse for orders, returns, messaging, support and wallet. Each source answers within overviewSourceTimeoutMs or is reported in `unavailable`; the page never fails because one module is slow or off. Builders: those modules must expose countInProgress, listRecentForCustomer, listDelayedItemsForCustomer (orders), listOpenForCustomer (returns), unreadCount (messaging, exists), listOpenCasesForCustomer (support) and getBalance (wallet) in their contracts.

Marketing consent is the source of truth here; notifications reads getMarketingConsent and consumes customers.marketing_preferences.changed. Notification channel routing and essential notices stay in notifications. This resolves the overlap between 'marketing preferences' (customers) and 'preferences (essential vs promotional)' (notifications) in the architecture doc.

Guest order lookup is served here (architecture doc); the access grant itself is identity's (grantGuestOrderAccess on the caller's guest session), so orders, shipping, returns and support only check identity.hasGuestOrderAccess. Needs orders to expose findGuestOrder(orderRef, email) and listGuestOrdersByEmail(email).

Approval action registered with access: customers.accounts.close-with-obligations (limit none, secondReviewer always; see approvalActions) for staff closures while orders, returns or cases are still open.
Account actions call identity in-process: send_password_reset uses the forced-reset tool, sign_out_everywhere uses revokeSessions, completed closure uses closeAccount.

Customer restrictions applied directly by staff are appealed through a support case (route stated in appealRoute). Restrictions that come from a trust enforcement are appealed in trust (POST /api/store/trust/appeals).
Address changes never alter accepted orders: checkout copies the address via getAddressForOrder and orders store that copy.

Customer location (owner decision 2026-10-22): the customer's point is their saved default delivery address, geocoded on the server when it is saved (create, edit, checkout save) and by the customers.geocode-addresses backfill. No device location permission. Coordinates stay internal: store address responses do not carry them; modules that show distances read customerLocation and use kernel/lib/geo.ts. A failed geocode never fails the save.
